messages:
maya: hey team, quick midnight handoff. i'm primary for the shift -> alex will take over now, kevin is secondary. :wave:
maya: summary: embeddings-encoder in eu-west is hitting a rate-limit/throttling pattern since ~23:10 UTC. some Dedicated customers see 429s and elevated p99 token latency. not a full outage but customer impact for high-throughput routes.
maya: active alerts:
- grafana: embeddings-encoder.request_429_rate > 5% (5m)
- datadog: latency.p99.tokens > 1.2s for route /v1/embeddings (eu-west)
- k8s: pod restart spike on embeddings-encoder pool-a

incident-bot: INC-2026-901 created (automated page). priority: P2. assigned to oncall.

alex: acked. i'm taking primary now. brief status and what i've done so far:
- validated 429s correlate with a recent traffic burst from a few enterprise tenants (tenant ids: T-762, T-991). those requests are large batch embedding calls (~2k vectors).
- increased embeddings-encoder replica count from 6 -> 10 in eu-west to absorb burst: `kubectl scale deployment embeddings-encoder -n prod --replicas=10`
- warmed up KV cache for common prefixes by replaying a small prefix set (internal runbook step)

alex: mitigation in progress: autoscaler lag is ~90s which caused initial throttling. i've temporarily raised target CPU and set a short cooldown to get faster scale-up. monitoring CPU and request queue length.

kevin: FYI, i'm watching rate-limiter metrics. looks like the token-bucket refill for route `/v1/embeddings` was misaligned after a config deploy earlier today (rate-limiter config v2.3.1). i can revert if scaling doesn't help.

priya: customer comms: tickets created for impacted tenants; initial note sent. recommending we keep customers updated every 30m until p95/p99 stabilize.

alex: runbook pointers (quick):
- ops playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/embeddings-rate-throttle
- k8s commands:
```
# scale e2e
kubectl get hpa -n prod embeddings-encoder
kubectl scale deployment embeddings-encoder -n prod --replicas=10
kubectl logs -f deployment/embeddings-encoder -c encoder -n prod --since=10m | grep "429\|rate_limiter"
```
- rate-limiter revert (only if scaling + config tweak fail): `deploy/rate-limiter rollback v2.3.0` (require approval)

opsbot: autoscaler event: scale-up triggered for embeddings-encoder pool-a -> +4 pods at 23:12:18 UTC.

alex: observed logs (summarized):
```
[23:11:02] encoder: incoming batch size=1987 tenant=T-762 route=/v1/embeddings -> enqueued
[23:11:04] rate_limiter: bucket_exhausted route=/v1/embeddings tenant=T-762
[23:11:05] http: respond 429 tenant=T-762 path=/v1/embeddings
[23:12:20] autoscaler: new pod ready embeddings-encoder-7
```

kevin: current numbers (23:30 UTC):
- 429 rate: 2.6% (down from 6.8%)
- p99 tokens: 980ms (down from 1.35s)
- active replicas: 10 (target)

alex: next steps for incoming oncall (actionable checklist):
1) watch grafana board "embeddings eu-west" - panels: `429 rate`, `p99 tokens`, `request queue length`
2) verify HPA/Cluster autoscaler events and node pressure (`kubectl describe hpa`, `kubectl get nodes`), escalate infra if nodes unschedulable
3) check recent deploys: `gitops/history --service embeddings-encoder --last 3` (rollback if you see rate-limiter config change)
4) if 429 persists > 10 minutes and replicas already > 12, open page to infra-sizing and SRE lead (priya)

priya: escalation criteria: page me when either:
- 429 rate > 5% for 10m, or
- p99 tokens > 2s and customer tickets increasing

alex: temporary safety fallback we enabled: for affected tenants we enabled per-tenant small-batch fallback (forces batching window to 50ms, reduces memory but increases latency slightly). command: `curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/tenants/T-762/fallback -d '{"emb_batch_ms":50}'`

maya: a few notes for audit and postmortem: capture tenant traces, batch sizes, and autoscaler timings. add the `embeddings-throttle` tag to the incident.

kevin: i'm watching logs and will step in to revert rate-limiter config if we see error patterns like `rate_limiter: refill_mismatch`.

alex: monitoring links:
- grafana: https://grafana.redwood/board/embeddings-eu-west
- datadog: https://app.datadoghq.com/dash/embeddings-eu-west
- logs: https://logs.redwood/stream?query=embeddings-encoder%20eu-west

incident-bot: scheduled update every 15m. next automated update at 23:45 UTC.

maya: handoff checklist completed. alex will be primary until 03:00 UTC, kevin is secondary. i'm reachable for questions for the first 30m. leaving the thread open — please post updates here (short), and tag `@priya` if we need to escalate. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks maya. taking over now. will post a concise update every 15 minutes or on any change. :white_check_mark:
